digest.component_or_area: plan clarity gate (standalone clarity + deterministic P1 plan-review)
propositions: The length-and-heading clarity heuristic fails to reject empty parsed Acceptance Criteria items and unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections.
A shared pure plan-structure helper should flag an Acceptance Criteria checkbox as defective only when its fully joined continuation body is whitespace-empty.
Sentinel tokens TBD, TODO, FIXME, and ??? in active sections must fire only in value positions and be ignored inside fenced or inline code.
Same-line removal or negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without) must suppress a sentinel match.
The shared floor result must be wired identically into standalone clarity and plan-review deterministic P1 while preserving the legacy compatibility clarity score.
Both gate surfaces must block on empty checkbox bodies and unresolved sentinel assignments while passing historical negative controls like 'NO stale TODO'.
